description:
## Scope

In pkix-difftest/src/oracles/openssl.rs, when Chain.crls is non-empty, write each DER CRL into the tempdir as a PEM file and add -CRLfile + -crl_check (or -crl_check_all) to the openssl verify command line.

## What

- When chain.crls.is_empty(): existing behavior.
- Otherwise:
  - Write each DER CRL as crl_N.pem in the tempdir (use the same approach as cert tempdir-writing).
  - For multi-CRL: openssl verify accepts -CRLfile once but reads concatenated PEM, so concat all into a single crls.pem.
  - Add -CRLfile crls.pem and -crl_check_all (verifies entire chain) to the command.

## Notes

- OpenSSL 3.x: -crl_check checks the leaf only; -crl_check_all checks all certs in the chain. Most PKITS revocation testcases revoke the EE — -crl_check_all matches RFC 5280 §6.3 (revocation per-cert in chain). Decision: use -crl_check_all for full-chain coverage.

## Acceptance

- [ ] OpenSSL oracle plumbs Chain.crls into a tempdir crls.pem.
- [ ] -CRLfile and -crl_check_all are added to the command.
- [ ] One test verifying a PKITS revoked-leaf chain returns Fail with reason mentioning 'revoked' or 'CRL'.

## Depends on

PKIX-emf1.1.

## Parent

PKIX-emf1.
title: Wire OpenSSL oracle to use -CRLfile + -crl_check when Chain.crls is non-empty
